Bitstream diff: two 7-series .bit files, frame by frame

Drop two Xilinx 7-series bitstreams: header, packets and every 101-word frame compared in your browser, the first differing frame address decoded. Nothing is uploaded.

A file you open here is read by your browser only: it is never uploaded. The page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.
